test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

The storm passed ________ but the night remained warm.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 - quickly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires an adverb to describe how the storm passed.
 
• We use adverbs to add more information about a verb, an adjective, another adverb, a clause, or a whole sentence.
 
• "**Quickly**" is the appropriate adverb as it describes **the speed** at which the storm passed.
 
• The use of comparative forms such as "quicker" or "quickest" would be incorrect as there is no comparison being made.
 
• "Quick" is an adjective and does not fit grammatically in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete sentence:** *The storm passed quickly __but the night remained warm.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 - "**quickest**" is a superlative form of the adjective "quick" and cannot be used as an adverb.
 
• Option 2 - "**quicker**" is a comparative form of the adjective "quick" and cannot be used as an adverb without the suffix "**-ly**".
 
• Option 4 - "**quick**" is an adjective and cannot be used to describe how the storm passed.
